messages:
sanjay: FYI team — preflight for Tokyo region (jp-tokyo-2) marketplace listing. Need to confirm partner entitlements, GPU family support, and quota numbers by EOD Wed. Key asks:
- confirm marketplace SKU naming with GCP partner
- committed vGPU / node counts for first 30d
- legal approval for joint press window

elena: @sanjay I'm pulling the marketplace checklist. GCP needs estimated monthly node-hours + image scan report. I'll attach in the PR.

maya: For capacity, NVIDIA A100 SKUs are available in jp-tokyo-2 but limited. We should also request Ampere alternatives. Suggested 50 reserved GPUs day1 to start. :thinking_face:

tom: Ops: we need quota requests in this form to GCP support:
```
Project: redwood-prod-tokyo
Service: compute.googleapis.com
Quota: GPUs (NVIDIA A100) = 50
Quota: GPUs (Ampere) = 20
```
I'll open the ticket after we sync numbers.

nari: Legal: draft statement for partner joint announcement — timeline ok to lock after infra confirmation. Also need data processing addendum for APAC customers. Will review.

elena: Also, marketplace listing requires a security contact and vulnerability scan artifact (SBOM). @maya can you confirm the image scan is on latest base?

maya: Yes, image scan ran yesterday. SBOM uploaded to GCS at gs://sec-artifacts/jp-tokyo-2/sbom.json :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: ticket #PRJ-4872 created by tom — GCP quota request submitted. ETA 48-72h.

sanjay: Great. Two risk items: 1) if GP quotas delayed, we fallback to eu-north region for early alpha customers; 2) If Ampere supply lags, we may need to degrade to CPU-only for smaller tenants. Can product ops please prepare communication plan?

elena: I'll draft a short status doc and a canned customer note. Will post link in this thread when done.

tom: Opening the quota ticket now, adding a note for expedited review mentioning joint marketplace listing and enterprise SLA.

maya: Quick ask for partners team — can we confirm the partner (CloudHarbor) contact for the joint announcement? I have Priya listed but want to double-check.

sanjay: Priya (CloudHarbor) is confirmed. @elena can you loop in partner-led PR and pick a 2-week window starting Apr 20?

elena: Ack. Tentative window Apr 20-34? (typo meant Apr 20-24) :sweat_smile:

nari: Legal flagged one clause about customer audit rights in APAC — will send suggested redline in 24h.

sanjay: Thanks all. Action items:
- tom: submit/expedite quota ticket (#PRJ-4872)
- maya: confirm fallback AMIs + SBOM link
- elena: marketplace checklist + PR to partners
- nari: legal redline
We'll reconvene Tomorrow 10:00 JST. :rocket:

elena: :thumbsup:
